title: Marvel Mix-Up: Avengers, Inhumans & Asgardians
script: This is an Avenger. This is a Defender. So what's the difference? Avengers are Earth's mightiest heroes, often government-backed, tackling global threats. Defenders are street-level heroes, dealing with local issues. This is an Inhuman. This is a Kree. So what's the difference? Inhumans are humans genetically altered by Kree experimentation. Kree are an alien race, often the manipulators. This is an Asgardian. This is a Jotun. So what's the difference? Asgardians are powerful beings from Asgard. Jotuns are Frost Giants, their ancient enemies. Follow for more.
